info.title: Confera admin API
info.description: The API of the admin surface. It answers only under the admin host name.

default.description: Any error, in the one error format of the API (RFC 9457 problem details). An unexpected error carries `code` and `traceId` only.

post.summary:
Asks for an email change; needs the current password. A link to confirm it goes to the
new address, a notice to the old one and to every active admin. 409 `email_taken` when
the address belongs to an account already.

default.description: Any error, in the one error format of the API (RFC 9457 problem details). An unexpected error carries `code` and `traceId` only.

post.summary:
Changes the own password; needs the current one. Ends every other session of the user,
and tells every active admin. A new password that breaks a rule is refused with 400
`password_refused` and each broken rule named (`password_length`, `password_common`,
`password_personal`, `password_mismatch`).

Asks for a password reset. The answer is 202 and nothing else, for every address, after
the same time: whether an account has it, is active, is in the cool-down of an earlier
request or has reached its daily cap, is not told.

post.summary:
Signs in. Every failure answers alike (401 `sign_in_failed`), after the same time: an
unknown address, a wrong password, a braked account or address, an account that is
deactivated, invited or removed. Sets the session cookie and, for a browser that was
not a known device of the account, the device cookie.

default.description: Any error, in the one error format of the API (RFC 9457 problem details). An unexpected error carries `code` and `traceId` only.

get.summary:
The signed-in user, the organisation and the CSRF value of the session. A request with
the header `X-Confera-Background` (a refetch the person did not ask for) does not renew
the session.

delete.summary: Ends every session of the user (an admin's "end this user's sessions", ADR-03).

actor.description: Who did it; null for the system (a summary).

action.description: One of the actions of the audit log, for example `user.role_changed`.

fields.description: The names of the fields that changed.

changes.description: Old and new value, only for the fields whose values the log keeps (settings that are not personal).

detail.description: Counts and periods of a summary.

password.description: The current password: an email change needs it (ADR-03).

newEmail.description: The new address. The change is confirmed from it.

newPasswordRepeat.description: The second entry of the new password: both entries must match.

code.description: Two capital letters: IT, ER, EM, LI, AI.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Belgrade.

confirmationValidUntil.description: The password asked again is valid until this moment, in this session only.

listedSites.description: At most 20; each is checked and kept as an origin (ST-30).

newEmail.description: The address the account will have once the change is confirmed.

path.description: Path of the field in the request, for example `authors.0.email`.

code.description: Stable code of the rule that failed, for example `isEmail`. Never the value.

email.description: The address the invitation goes to; the user signs in with it.

expiresAt.description: The link stops working at this moment.

serverName.description: The name of the server when it was used.

errorCode.description: A code, never the server's words.

serverName.description: The name of the server when it was used.

errorCode.description: A code, never the server's words.

tlsMode.description: implicit (TLS from the first byte), starttls (required), none (developer machines only).

credentialSet.description: Whether a password is stored. The password itself is never returned.

credentialSetAt.description: When the stored password was set.

isDefault.description: The organisation's default server, last in the order of FR-SMTP-02.

isFallback.description: Tried when sending through the chosen server fails.

sendRatePerMinute.description: Messages a minute the worker sends through this server at most.

subject.description: A subject document: type subject, with text and placeholder children.

body.description: A body document: type doc, with block children.

mailServerId.description: The server of this template, first in the order of FR-SMTP-02.

version.description:
Version of the API (SemVer), the same as `info.version` of the OpenAPI document.
A client built for another major version must stop and ask for a reload.

name.description: The short name shown in the application.

vatNoteSr.description: The note on documents that the association is exempt from VAT, in Serbian.

rsdAccount.description: The account for payments in RSD.

paypalPayee.description: The PayPal account that receives payments.

paymentDetailsChangedAt.description: When the payment details were changed last; the issue screen shows it for 14 days.

mailLogContent.description: Whether the mail log keeps the subject and body of what was sent (FR-SMTP-04).

version.description: Sent back with a change: a change made on an older version is refused (409).

password.description: The password of the signed-in user, asked again before a sensitive change.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code, for example `not_found` or `validation_failed`.

traceId.description: Identifies this request in the server log.

status.description: HTTP status. Absent on an unknown error.

title.description: Short English name of the status. Absent on an unknown error.

errors.description: The refused fields, when the input was not valid.

email.description: The address of the account. The answer is the same whether it belongs to one or not.

csrf.description:
The value of the `X-CSRF-Token` header that every changing request of this session
carries (ADR-03). Bound to the session; never in a cookie.

idleExpiresAt.description: The session ends at this moment unless it is used before (24 hours after the last use).

absoluteExpiresAt.description: The session ends at this moment whatever happens (7 days after sign-in).

confirmationValidUntil.description: Until when the password asked again is valid in this session; null when it was not asked.

secondFactor.description: The step of the second factor (built in 0.9.0): not_required, pending or passed.

roles.description: The roles of the user: admin, reviewer.

passwordRepeat.description: The second entry: both entries must match.

email.description: The email address of the account.

carriesLink.description: Whether a message of this type carries a secure link: the address of a link node.

listedSites.description: At most 20; each is checked and kept as an origin (ST-30).

mailLogContent.description: Whether the mail log keeps the content of what was sent (FR-SMTP-04).

invitationDelivery.description:
For an invited user, what became of the latest invitation message: `queued` (to be
sent), `waiting_for_server` (no mail server can send it yet; it goes out once one is
configured, with a link made then), `sent` or `failed`. Null for anyone else, and for
an invitation that was given by hand (the first admin).

status.description: invited (no password yet), active, deactivated or removed.

version.description: Sent back with a change: a change made on an older version is refused (409).

total.description: How many users match, over all pages.

version.description: The version the change is made on.
